description:
Located within the highly sought-after Ocean Village development, Austin & Wyatt are delighted to present this well-presented second-floor apartment, offering spacious and versatile accommodation in a desirable marina-side setting.

The property features a generous open-plan living and dining area, creating a bright and inviting space that is ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The accommodation comprises two well-proportioned bedrooms and a neat, well-appointed bathroom, providing comfortable and practical living throughout.

A particular highlight is the private balcony overlooking the beautiful and well manicured communal garden, providing a pleasant outdoor space to enjoy, creating an attractive and peaceful setting within this private development. The property also benefits from an allocated parking space, adding further convenience.

Ocean Village is one of central Southampton’s most desirable residential locations, perfectly positioned close to the marina with an excellent selection of top restaurants, cafés and local amenities including a 5-star hotel and spa. Southampton city centre is also within easy reach, making this an ideal location for those seeking the perfect blend of city living and a waterfront lifestyle.

Whether you're a first-time buyer, investor or simply looking for a stylish home in a vibrant marina-side community, this apartment represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a property in one of Southampton’s most sought-after developments.
